summary: Create lighting setup (preview): forks a setup into a new one of the person's own.
name: preview.createLightingSetup

capability.when: The view's rig is one of the person's own setups, or a built-in (a change to a built-in forks it into one of the person's own first).

refusals.reason: A setup has at most 16 lights and a few shadow casters.
A built-in setup can't be renamed or deleted.

effect.commit: Forks a setup into a new one of the person's own.
